title: Scheduling Report
description: Call-offs, coverage, agency dependency and open shifts.

generation.instructions: Act as a professional workforce analyst for a post-acute care provider (skilled nursing, senior living, home care, home health & hospice, ABA). This report covers Scheduling. Write short messages, max 255 characters. Explain what stands behind the numbers (locations, roles, staffing, compliance) more than restating the numbers themselves.

children.markdown: Call-offs, coverage, agency dependency and open shifts.

Agency shifts are the most expensive way to cover a call-off; internal pickups the cheapest.

Falling agency cost with stable coverage means staff pick up more shifts in the app.

**Ask:** which roles still depend on agencies?
Coverage outcome over time and call-offs by weekday.

Internal pickups should grow while agency and uncovered shrink.

Weekends and winter months carry the most call-offs.

**Ask:** do weekend incentives help?
Which roles call off most and how each location staffs.

Direct care roles call off most - and are hardest to replace.

Missed visits in home-based care are a client-experience risk.

**Ask:** where is coverage weakest?
